products.name: Camel Cow Leather Trucker Jacket
products.shortDescription: Cropped cow leather trucker jacket in warm camel, with contrast stitching, flap chest pockets and a metal zip front.
products.description:
A modern take on the classic trucker jacket, made from genuine cow leather in a warm camel tone with a soft, matte finish. Light contrast topstitching along the seams, yoke and pockets gives it a crafted, workwear-inspired look.

It has a pointed shirt-style collar, a full-length metal zip, two flap chest pockets with silver snap buttons and snap-button cuffs. The panelled front and back yoke add structure, and a neat hem band keeps the silhouette clean. The slightly cropped, regular cut sits at the waist, so it works with high-waisted denim, tailored trousers or a skirt, and layers easily over a turtleneck or fine knit.

Cow leather is durable and develops a richer character with wear. Natural grain variations are part of each piece.

specs.label: Pockets
specs.value: 2 flap chest pockets with snap buttons, 2 side pockets

products.name: Camel Cow Leather Stand-Collar Jacket
products.shortDescription: Cropped Cow Leather jacket in warm camel, with a stand collar, silver zip front and zippered pockets.
products.description:
A clean, modern jacket in a soft camel Cow Leather finish. The matte texture and warm tone give it a polished look, and the structured stand collar with a snap tab keeps the neckline sharp and wraps your neck against the wind.

It has a full-length silver zip, two slim zippered hand pockets and zip-detail cuffs. Seam lines across the back yoke and a neat hem band add subtle structure. The slightly cropped, regular cut sits at the hip, so it layers well over a turtleneck or fine knit and pairs easily with wide-leg denim, tailored trousers or boots.

The jacket is lined with soft merino for warmth without bulk, and merino’s natural breathability helps regulate temperature through the day. Natural variations in the suede are part of the character of each piece.

products.name: Camel Shearling Zip Vest
products.shortDescription: Sleeveless zip-front vest in soft camel merino shearling, with a turn-down collar and two front pockets.
products.description:
A cosy sleeveless vest made from plush merino shearling in a warm camel tone. The dense, soft pile adds warmth to your core while keeping your arms free, which makes it an easy layering piece for the colder months.

It has a wide turn-down collar, a metal front zip and two roomy front pockets set low on the body. The relaxed, slightly boxy cut sits at the hip, so it works over a fitted knit, a turtleneck or a shirt, and pairs well with dark denim, wide-leg trousers or boots.

Merino is naturally breathable and temperature-regulating, so the vest keeps you warm without feeling bulky. Natural variations in the pile and colour are part of the character of each piece.

specs.value: Merino shearling (wool pile with suede-finish backing)

products.name: Tobacco Suede Coat with Shearling Trim
products.shortDescription: Mid-length suede coat in warm tobacco brown, with a soft merino shearling collar, cuffs and hem.
products.description:
A warm, elegant coat in a rich tobacco-brown suede finish, trimmed with plush merino shearling at the collar, cuffs and hem. The contrast between the smooth, matte suede and the soft, deep pile gives it a refined, vintage-inspired look.

It has a single-breasted front with five horn-style buttons and two slanted front pockets that keep your hands warm and the silhouette clean. The slightly A-line cut falls just above the knee, so it moves easily and layers well over knitwear, with dark denim, tailored trousers or boots.

The soft shearling lining and trim keep the cold out, and merino’s natural breathability helps regulate temperature so the coat never feels heavy. Natural variations in the suede and the pile are part of the character of each piece.

products.name: Black Shearling Aviator Jacket
products.shortDescription: Real leather aviator jacket with a warm merino shearling collar and lining, in black.
products.description:
A classic aviator silhouette made from genuine black leather, lined with soft merino wool for real warmth. The oversized shearling collar can be worn open or fastened with the adjustable buckle strap at the neck.

A heavy metal front zip and two zippered side pockets give it a clean, structured look. The seamed hem band and cuffs add the traditional flight-jacket detail. The relaxed, slightly cropped cut works over knitwear and pairs well with wide-leg denim or tailored trousers.

Merino is naturally breathable and temperature-regulating, so the jacket stays warm without feeling heavy. Each piece has its own natural leather grain, so small variations are part of its character.
